correctness.rationale: At a Gibbs start at beta0, a single beta1 Glauber step on energies (0,A,A,B) gives p1(--)-p1(+-)=H(B)/(2Z), H=(3g-1)(y+z)-f(1+y), with y=exp(-beta0 A), z=exp(-beta0 B), f=(1+exp(beta1 A))^-1, g=(1+exp(beta1(B-A)))^-1. Next-temperature local passivity is -tanh(beta2(B-A)/2)H/Z. H(A)>0, H(A+log(2)/beta1)<0 and H strictly decreases while 3g-1>0; afterwards H<0. Thus unique B* and the strictly nonempty ferromagnetic interval A<B<min(B*,2A), even for arbitrarily small positive cooling. Independent four-state rational calculation reproduced H(5)=293719/16000000, P(--)= -293719/163334085 and normalized populations for A=4, B=5, beta0=log(20/19), beta1=log(3/2), beta2=log2; one spin reaches beta1 Gibbs in one update. The analytic derivative, not the finite witness, proves the full parameter theorem.
